vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: justoneapi-xiaohongshu-pgy
Version: 1.0.3

This skill bundle is a standard API wrapper for the Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) provided by JustOneAPI. The core logic in `bin/run.mjs` is a clean implementation that uses the native `fetch` API to interact with `https://api.justoneapi.com`, with no evidence of obfuscation, shell execution, or unauthorized data exfiltration. The instructions in `SKILL.md` are well-aligned with the stated purpose and include appropriate security warnings regarding the handling of the `JUST_ONE_API_TOKEN` environment variable.

llm.summary: The skill is an API wrapper for JustOneAPI's Xiaohongshu (Pugongying) endpoints and its requested binaries and single token credential align with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, required binary (node), and the required environment variable JUST_ONE_API_TOKEN all align with an HTTP API wrapper that runs a Node script to call api.justoneapi.com. No unrelated credentials or binaries are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md limits runtime behavior to selecting an operation, collecting required API parameters, and invoking the included Node helper with the provided token. It does not instruct reading unrelated system files or exfiltrating data to third-party endpoints beyond the declared base URL (api.justoneapi.com).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no external install spec (low risk), but the skill includes an executable Node script (bin/run.mjs) that will be run by the agent. Executing packaged code is expected for this kind of wrapper, but users should understand that the bundled script will execute locally and perform network calls.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one environment credential is required (JUST_ONE_API_TOKEN) and it is the primary credential used for authenticating requests to JustOneAPI, which matches the skill's purpose. No unrelated secrets or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-on and does not request elevated persistence. It does allow autonomous invocation (the platform default), which is normal; there is no evidence it alters other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for calling JustOneAPI's Xiaohongshu endpoints, but before installing: 1) Confirm you trust the publisher/JustOneAPI (api.justoneapi.com). 2) Keep JUST_ONE_API_TOKEN private and consider using a scoped or ephemeral token if available. 3) Review the bundled bin/run.mjs yourself (it will be executed) if you want to verify there are no unexpected network endpoints or behaviors. 4) Be aware the skill will make network requests that include any identifiers you provide (userId, kolId, etc.). 5) If you are uncomfortable with autonomous agent invocation, restrict or review agent permissions before enabling the skill.
